scope: Isolated PostgreSQL 16 and local backend validation; no cloud deployment or real-account verification
schema: All 15 migrations applied from empty local database

concurrency.sameUser8Calls: 8 active responses, same application ID, 1 membership, 1 invite use

security: SECURITY INVOKER preserved; anon/authenticated cannot execute trusted actor RPC
Removed membership remains removed until manual restoration; restored role is member
Blocked account, invalid/revoked/expired/malformed/exhausted invitation and stale consent rejected
Forced unique conflict rolls back application, profile and invite count
Moderation definition differs from applied baseline only by shared membership advisory lock
historicalPending: Admission requires another apply call with current rules consent and a valid invite. Reusing the original code keeps its reserved use; replacing it consumes the new code once. Existing pending rows are not bulk activated.
